(3) `(allow default)(deny file-write*)(allow file-write* (subpath …))` is a working write allow-list; `(deny file-read* (subpath …))` seals reads; rm/mv/chmod/symlink-escape are all caught. The sofar-evaluator repo (~/IO/sofar-evaluator, self-improve 3.1) encodes these; its `selftest` command proves them on the current machine.
